name: cause_effect_valid_vs_invalid_paired
description: Paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for ordinary outcomes versus outcomes that do not follow normal physical or practical sequence.

valid_cause_effect.text: A person knocks over a cup. Water spreads across the table.
Someone cuts a sheet of paper with scissors. Two smaller pieces rest on the desk.
A person opens a window during a rainstorm. Drops land on the windowsill.
Someone drops a ceramic plate onto the floor. Several pieces scatter near the chair.

invalid_cause_effect.text: A person knocks over a cup. The table becomes completely dry.
Someone cuts a sheet of paper with scissors. The paper becomes one smooth sheet again.
A person opens a window during a rainstorm. The windowsill becomes covered in dust.
Someone drops a ceramic plate onto the floor. The plate sits unbroken on the shelf.
